audit.why: Even skill matchup (49.9% WR, 2381 games). Qiyana wins early-mid via burst before his sustain scales; Sylas takes over at two items — page reflects this.
Spikes correct: Qiyana 3/6/first item, Sylas two-item sustain-bruiser takeover with R Hijack (80/55/30s) getting cheap late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field carries no numbers; full-layer level chart shows blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content and packet both name Qiyana L1-first-item and Sylas 2+ items.
audit.why: Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct) 13s rank 1 is his only escape and his engage; W Kingslayer 12s heal defines extended trades; R Hijack steals Qiyana's R. Chart flipped to match content+packet with grounded whys.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added; chart sides set to Qiyana x6 / Sylas with matching whys.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Terrashape (element swap) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — the dash into chain-pull governs your forward steps; all-in the moment he burns it. - His W Kingslayer heal runs a 12s clock early. - Your R is 120s — hold it for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Break vision in brush between trades — his Q and E need line of sight, and re-entering from grass resets the angle he prepared.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Open ground favors his chain-pull and W sustain — no wall for your R, no brush reset, and he heals through the duel.

edits.before: Grass Q from the river brush line — the stealth-empowered poke chunks and the lane learns to fear hedges.
edits.after: Grass Q from brush chunks a mana-starved Sylas — he has no W heal yet, so the empowered poke goes unanswered.

edits.before: W element economy begins: ice for the trades, rock for the executes, grass for the angles.
edits.after: W elements come online and sidestepping his second Chain Lash hit guts his trade — you stay ahead.

edits.before: E joins: the stick-dash into ice-Q root is your first real kill pattern — pick one window per wave.
edits.after: E joins: E-ice-Q burst beats his short W heal-trades — commit while his 13s E dash is on cooldown.

edits.before: Element-cycle the trades: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line. The lane is a terrain quiz.
edits.after: Short explosive combos out-damage his sustain through 4-5 — always commit on his E dash cooldown.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: Your R burst outpaces his lane healing at 6 — but he can Hijack it, so bait the steal or fight with it down.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: First item: the one-rotation string kills before his W and passive can heal it back.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: Two items on, his sustain out-heals your burst and Hijack turns duels — flank squishies, stop fighting him.

notes: Full-layer chart flipped from blanket Skill to Qiyana x6 / Sylas at 2+ items — content win[] already held those values (no win[] edits needed; no-ops would be rejected) and the packet levelChart agrees exactly. Content layer was already high quality with real ability names. Anti-heal need (missing interaction) is already covered by report[8].t. Sylas R Hijack CD 80/55/30 from kit.
